said on Friday that it priced $60M of fixed-rate mandatory redeemable preferred stock (MRPS) via a private placement.
The funding is expected in Q4 2026.
The proceeds will be used to refinance existing debt and fund new portfolio investments.
The offering includes $20M each of Series S, T, and U MRPS, carrying fixed rates of 6.27%, 6.43%, and 6.15%, respectively.
The securities mature between 2029 and 2033, with all three series carrying a $35 liquidation preference.

title: ClearBridge Energy Midstream Opportunity prices $60M MRPS offering
